string.text: Your character, kept on this computer

How your character relates to the save. Off: the mod does nothing. Otherwise, loading a save that was not last played with your profile opens the profile menu, where you choose who you play. Character follows the save: the profile is written each time you save, and loading a save played with it gives you the character from that save (die and reload, and you have what you had at that save). Character lives in the profile: the profile is written whenever your character changes, and loading a save gives you the profile's character, whatever the save holds; loading an older save rolls back the world, not you. Either way, health and bleeding stay with the save. Each player picks their own. Turned on during a game, it starts when you next load a save or join; turned off, it stops at once.
Your money is set to the profile's.
Rank and reputation are set to the profile's.
Each faction's goodwill toward you is set to the profile's. How factions feel about each other stays with the world.
Your true faction is set to the profile's. Relations between factions belong to the world and do not change. Untested in co-op: the host may set your faction back.
Hunger, thirst and sleepiness are set to the profile's.
Skill levels and experience (Skill System) are set to the profile's.
Skill tree: the class, the perks bought, the XP of every class and the secondary craft are set to the profile's. Only when Skill tree is enabled; without it the profile keeps what it has.
Recipes the profile knows are learned. Recipes already known in this game stay known.

Only for "Character lives in the profile", and only when nothing else keeps you alive (DANTE, Azazel, Soulslike). Off: after a death and reload you have the gear you carried a moment before dying. Health and bleeding are the save's. On: the profile loses everything you carried except the binoculars, PDA and torch you have equipped.
Each profile is one character. Choose which one you play in the profile menu (its key, or the button above): it opens after a load when needed, and remembers your choice for the next game.\n
Letters, digits, _ and - (up to 32). Then press Create.
Makes a new, empty profile. The first time you choose it in the profile menu, it takes the character you have at that moment.
The active profile and default cannot be removed.
The profile is removed only if this matches its name exactly.
Takes the profile off the list. Its character is kept in a backup file next to it (persistent_stalkers_profile_NAME.removed-TIME.txt in the game's appdata folder).
Opens the profile menu during play: every profile with its loadout, to switch to another one. Your current profile is saved first.
Pause the game while the profile menu is open (solo)
Experimental. The menu shows after a load, when the world is already running. Off: the world goes on while you choose.
